title: TCIL pays Dividend of ₹ 43.86 Crore for the Year 2025-26 to the Government of India
body_text:
Telecommunications Consultants India Ltd. (TCIL) today paid dividend of Rs. 43.86 crore to the Government of India for the year 2025-26. Chairman & Managing Director Shri Syed Tausif Abbas presented the dividend cheque to Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia, Union Minister of Communications and DoNER, in the presence of Shri Amit Agrawal, Secretary, Department of Telecommunications (DoT).
TCIL was established in August, 1978 and is under the administrative control of the Department of Telecommunications, Government of India. The Government holds 100% equity in the Company. In 2025-26, TCIL achieved an operating revenue of ₹ 3,335 Crore and earned a profit after tax of ₹ 146 Crore.
In the last 5 years, revenue of TCIL has grown by 115% (from ₹ 1,596 Crore in FY 2021-22 to ₹ 3,442 Crore in FY 2025-26). TCIL is a profit making Miniratna PSU and have paid a cumulative dividend of ₹ 4,146 Crore to the Government, including special dividend of ₹ 3,728 Crore in FY 2024-25.
TCIL is a diversified CPSE executing Projects in the field of Telecommunications & Information Technology in India and abroad. TCIL has executed projects in over 70 countries across the globe. Its overseas operations are currently in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Mauritius, Bhutan & Nepal apart from the ongoing prestigious Pan Africa e-Vidya Bharti & Arogya Bharti Network project operating in more than 15 African countries.
The Company is also executing prestigious high value Govt. of India projects of Defence NFS project, Navy OFC Projects, USOF funded APSFL & Telangana Fiber Projects, BBNL VSAT, BharatNet phase -III Project in North East, BSNL Super Edge Router Project, State Wide Area Network in Bihar and Data Centre projects for the Indian Coast Guard & in state of Chhattisgarh.
